key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:D28E
name: apply_bracketed_bonus_to_totals
description: Chooses a bonus tier from zero to three using two values returned by helper calls, then adds a quarter of a stored value times that tier to two stored totals. It clears one total and returns 1 when the second value exceeds two or a later helper check succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:D374
name: copy_entry_and_override_field
description: Calls a helper with two words from a per-slot record, then copies a two-word table entry into the slot selected by the counter. For the first slot it saves one field and replaces it with a stored value when a global counter equals five.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:D3E4
name: try_each_value_in_slot
description: Marks the current slot as active, then tries each value from two to five by storing it in the slot and calling a search helper. It returns 1 on the first nonzero helper result, otherwise clears the active flag and returns 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:D45A
name: scan_adjacent_board_squares
description: Records the origin square in the current search slot, then tests the squares around a reference square using an off-board mask and a piece-type match, calling a helper for each match. A second pass walks a direction table and returns 1 as soon as a helper reports success.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:D6D2
name: generate_piece_moves_by_type
description: Dispatches on the piece type stored in the current search slot. Each case walks a table of direction offsets, either one step or a sliding ray over empty squares, and calls a helper for every reachable square, returning 1 as soon as a helper reports success.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:DAF2
name: test_offset_pair_candidates
description: Walks a two-entry table of square offsets from the highest index down, storing each candidate square in the current slot and calling a checker. It returns 1 only when a checker succeeds and a second confirmation call also succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:DBE6
name: scan_midpoint_neighbour_squares
description: When the previous slot holds a marker value and a helper returns more than thirty-one, it stores the midpoint between two saved squares as the candidate and tests its neighbours. It returns 1 when a checker and a confirmation call both succeed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:DD7E
name: unwind_candidate_stack
description: Saves the current depth, then for each level down to zero swaps two stored words and calls a helper on that level's candidate. A final call on the top entry runs when a flag is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:DDFE
name: replay_candidate_stack
description: Optionally checks a flag and calls a helper for the next slot, advances the depth, then for each level up to the saved depth calls a helper on that candidate and swaps two stored words.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:DE7A
name: dispatch_pending_message_display
description: Runs two helper calls and an indirect library call, stores a returned value, then when a pending flag is set either shows the referenced text 'Jay was wrong #1' or clears the flag and sets a result to one for the second mode.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:E084
name: apply_piece_move_with_steps
description: Writes the moved piece to its destination in the board table, clearing or updating the origin, then steps from origin to destination one file and rank at a time. It calls helpers for each step and for captures, and sets a new state flag for the move.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F17C
name: register_two_resource_handles
description: Calls a registration helper twice, once with a buffer at one offset and identifier seven, and once with a second buffer and identifier eight. Each returned handle is stored in its own global slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F1B4
name: call_pair_when_idle
description: When a state word is zero, calls two helper routines in sequence. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F1D4
name: queue_audio_channel_command
description: When a state word is nonzero, writes a fixed block of eight command words to a shared global output word. It selects channel one or channel two from the low word of the second argument and clears that channel's per-channel field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F1EC
name: start_audio_channel_one
description: Starts playback on the first audio channel. It clears the channel's field, writes the DMA and interrupt control registers with disable-then-enable bits, loads the sample location, length and period from the caller's structure, and sets the channel volume register from a stored value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F248
name: start_audio_channel_zero
description: Starts playback on the zeroth audio channel. It clears the channel's field, writes the DMA and interrupt control registers, loads the sample location, length and period from the caller's structure, and sets the channel volume register from a stored value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F2A0
name: toggle_audio_channel_dma
description: Enables or disables DMA for one audio channel depending on whether the low word of the first argument is zero. It writes the matching channel bits to the DMA and interrupt control registers, then calls a library routine with argument two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F2BC
name: enable_audio_channel_zero_dma
description: Enables DMA for audio channel zero by writing its channel bit and the DMA master enable bit to the control registers. It then calls a library routine with argument two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F2DA
name: mute_audio_channels_zero_one
description: Disables DMA for audio channels zero and one by writing their control bits, and zeroes both channel volume registers. It then calls two helper routines with channel identifiers eight and seven and stored arguments.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F31A
name: initialise_object_by_first_use
description: Sets a per-object field to 256. If the global counter is zero it stores a pointer from a table and sets another field to 50, otherwise it sets two other fields to 256 and 2.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F33E
name: init_slot_pointer_and_timer
description: Stores a pointer taken from a global table into a per-object field and sets a second field to 50.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F34E
name: setup_object_on_first_use
description: Sets a per-object word to 128 and increments a global counter. The first call stores a table pointer and sets a timer field to 50; later calls set two other fields to 128 and 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F372
name: store_table_pointer_with_timer
description: Stores a pointer from a global table into a per-object field and sets the timer field to 50.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F5DA
name: lookup_table_value_bounded
description: Returns zero when the index exceeds 95. Otherwise it searches a global list of table pointers for a mask match, reads the table entry at the index, and returns it with the high bits set to 224 when a flag bit is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F5F2
name: lookup_table_value
description: Searches a global list of table pointers for the first entry whose mask matches the structure's flag word, reads the table entry at the index, and returns it with the high bits set to 224 when a flag bit is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F62A
name: open_trackdisk_device_port
description: Opens a message port for trackdisk.device through a library call and reports the fatal InitDisk message when the port or drive cannot be accessed. The referenced text 'Jay's Disk Port' matches that setup.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F74C
name: store_pair_and_clear_counter
description: Stores the low and high words of its 32-bit argument in two global words, then clears a third global word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F76A
name: store_word_and_clear_flag
description: Stores its argument in one global word and clears the following global word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F780
name: copy_in_512_byte_blocks
description: Transfers a byte count in 512-byte blocks, first aligning to the current block boundary and then copying whole blocks and a final partial block through helper calls. It advances two global offsets as it goes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F89A
name: transfer_sectors_from_track_offset
description: Converts the current position to a sector number by multiplying the track value by 22 and adding the block index. It then transfers 512-byte blocks through a helper, advancing the position and sector number for each block while the remaining count is positive.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F8C2
name: advance_block_transfer_loop
description: Repeatedly calls a helper with two pointers from a structure, then advances the global offset by 512, moves both pointers forward by 512 bytes, and increments the block counter while the remaining count stays positive.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F8F8
name: forward_or_flush_pending_request
description: When a counter is zero and a pending pointer is set, calls two helpers, a helper with a fixed table address, and a helper with the pending pointer. Otherwise it forwards the counter value to a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F914
name: flush_pending_request_pointer
description: When the pending pointer is set, calls two helper routines, a helper with a fixed table address, and a helper with the pending pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:F93E
name: seek_to_aligned_disk_position
description: Rounds the current byte position up to a 512-byte boundary and converts it to a sector number, adding two when the value exceeds 879. When the position differs from the target it seeks through the dos Seek wrapper, copies the block, and updates the position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FA06
name: queue_disk_request_type_two
description: Fills a 512-byte request block with a command word that has the high bit set and code two, plus the buffer and track offset, then passes it to a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FA3A
name: queue_disk_request_type_three
description: Fills a 512-byte request block with a command word that has the high bit set and code three, plus the buffer and track offset, then passes it to a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FA6C
name: retry_until_disk_ready
description: Repeatedly sets a drive status word and calls a helper with a fixed table address until the status reads zero. Each failed pass shows the referenced message 'Disk is write protected, try again.' through a library call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FAA4
name: delegate_to_disk_helper
description: Calls a single disk helper routine with no arguments and returns to its caller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FAD0
name: wait_for_inserted_disk
description: Polls a drive status word through a helper until the removed-disk value of twenty-nine clears. Each retry shows the referenced message 'Insert the BattleChess disk.' and pauses for 300 units once a disk is detected.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FB4C
name: read_block_and_restore_table
description: Copies a 13-word table onto the stack, issues a 512-byte read request through a helper, and copies the saved table back into the global buffer after the read succeeds or fails. The routine references the text 'Battle Chess'.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FC58
name: read_saves_block_with_restore
description: Copies a 13-word table onto the stack, sets a 512-byte read request at a fixed disk offset, calls a helper, and restores the table whether the read succeeds or fails. The routine references the text 'ChessSaves'.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FD34
name: restore_table_and_return_one
description: Saves a global word in the stack frame, restores a 13-word table from the stack copy into the global buffer, calls a helper, and returns 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FD36
name: restore_table_and_clear_status
description: Copies a 13-word table from the stack back into the global buffer, clears a global status word, and returns 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FD52
name: restore_table_after_status_save
description: Saves a global word in the stack frame, restores a 13-word table from the stack copy, calls a helper, and returns 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FD80
name: queue_disk_request_type_four
description: Sets the request word to command code four with the high bit set and passes the shared table to a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FD9C
name: start_disk_request_nine
description: When the request word is zero, sets it to nine, clears the follow-up word, and passes the shared table to a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FDC8
name: set_status_to_minus_one
description: Sets a global status word to minus one and returns it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FDE0
name: build_header_and_send_block
description: Fills a 129-byte stack buffer through a helper and writes eight and twelve into two header bytes. It then passes the buffer tail and a 32-byte block to helper routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FE24
name: wait_for_saves_disk
description: Polls through a helper until the saves disk is present. Each missing-disk pass shows the referenced message 'Insert the ChessSaves disk.', and a 300-unit pause follows once the disk has been missing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FE4E
name: delay_when_flag_set
description: When a word just before the frame is nonzero, pauses for 300 units through a library delay call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FE7E
name: clear_status_word
description: Sets a global status word to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FE8C
name: load_saved_game_list
description: Reads a 512-byte block into a stack buffer through helpers. If the read fails it shows the referenced message 'No games saved.'; otherwise it copies the slot entries from the block and calls a helper for each entry whose flag byte is zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FEC2
name: run_load_slot_selection
description: Reads the saves header and copies its entries, then calls a helper for each of eight slots whose flag byte is zero. It loops over the selection through library calls and references the 'Load' text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FFAA
name: handle_list_item_status
description: Walks list items by their status: statuses below eight call a helper and remember the status, status nine calls a helper and exits, and other values call a helper for the current item.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FFD0
name: update_selected_item_display
description: Reads the status of the current list item, calls a helper for it, and when the selection changes calls three display helpers and stores the new selection index.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FFE4
name: poll_list_selection_loop
description: Loops over list items, calling input and status helpers for each one and fetching the next entry through a helper until the status matches.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:FFE6
name: wait_until_list_status_changes
description: Repeats while the current status is zero or differs from the stored index, refreshing the status through helpers and updating the stored index on each pass.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:10006
name: reset_selection_and_poll
description: Stores the current item status as the stored index, then loops reading items through helpers and updating the selection value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:10012
name: dispatch_list_input_event
description: When the input code equals sixty-four, handles a list item by its status: items below eight are highlighted, status nine ends the loop, and other items call a helper and update the selection.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:10028
name: redraw_selected_list_row
description: Computes a row position from the selected item's index with a stride of 48 and a 31-unit offset, then calls helpers to draw it. When the change flag is set it calls three display helpers, then clears a highlight bit in a flag word and in each of eight entries.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:100CE
name: read_saves_block_and_list
description: Reads a 512-byte block into a stack buffer through a helper, stores a packed pair of values in a global, and calls a library routine. Helper calls then handle each list entry, and the excerpt does not show the whole body.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:1018E
name: run_slot_entry_loop
description: Clears a counter and loops over list entries. For each entry it reads a record from a pointer table, calls helpers that draw the row at fixed positions, and calls a library routine when the selection index is not minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:1020A
name: update_text_buffer_on_key
description: When an entry is selected, a key of type eight writes a space into the text buffer at the current position and moves the position left, clamping at zero. Other key types write their character and advance the position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:1023E
name: poll_text_input_loop
description: Clears the text position and loops reading input events through helpers. Events with code sixty-four are handed to a helper that processes the text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:10246
name: append_key_to_text_buffer
description: When the key record is not type thirteen and a helper accepts it, stores the record's character at the current text position, advances the position, and clamps it at fourteen. Type thirteen ends the entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:1028C
name: await_next_text_event
description: Clears a helper flag, then loops reading input events. Events with code sixty-four are dispatched to a helper that processes the text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:1028E
name: store_text_key_and_clamp
description: When a helper accepts the current event, stores the record byte at the text position, increments the position, and clamps it at fourteen. Then it polls for the next event.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:102C8
name: blink_text_cursor
description: When the cursor is active and a flag is set, swaps the character at the current position between a vertical bar and a space. It then redraws the 14-character text field through a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:102F6
name: draw_text_cursor_bar
description: Writes a vertical bar at the current text position, draws the 14-character field through a helper, and then loops reading input events.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:10320
name: clear_flag_then_poll_input
description: Sets a flag word to zero, then loops reading input events through helpers. Events with code sixty-four are dispatched to a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:10328
name: update_list_highlight_on_move
description: For an entry with index below eight, compares the current row with the stored row. A match clears the stored character or draws the row through a helper, and a mismatch moves the highlight with a helper call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][m cracktro removed]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][m cracktro removed].adf:Battlechess:0:1034E
name: clear_char_and_redraw_row
description: When the row index is not minus one and the position is not zero, sets the character at the position to zero, draws the row through a helper, and then polls for the next event.
